Quality improvement actions in the corpus document how healthcare organizations respond to data and reporting challenges. For [[region-sjaelland|Region Sjælland]], this involves addressing data integrity issues tied to specific clinical metrics. The region has launched an internal investigation into registration and data flow errors associated with [[indikator-8|Indikator 8]] [^src1]. This initiative highlights an organizational effort to correct underlying data infrastructure or reporting flaws that affect quality monitoring. The current evidence does not provide further details on the investigation's findings, timeline, or subsequent corrective measures.

## Claims
- Region Sjælland har iværksat en intern undersøgelse af registrerings- og dataflow-fejl i forbindelse med indikator 8 [^src1] (region-sjaelland, indikator-8)
